title: WpfDesignGuard configuration
description: Single source of truth for the WpfDesignGuard compile-time guard: scan scope, rule switches, token table, exemption ledger, hard-zero domains and the ratchet baseline.

version.description: Configuration format version. Only 1 is understood.

root.description: Base directory (relative to the project) that exemption and baseline paths resolve against.

include.description: Glob patterns (repo-relative, '/' separators) of the scanned surface. An empty list is a configuration error (anti-idle self-check).
Replaces the global include for this rule.

exclude.description: Adds to the global exclude for this rule.

perRule.description: Per-rule scan-surface overrides. Keys are rule IDs (DGxxxx).

rules.description: Unlisted rules are enabled with their catalog default severity.

spacingLadder.description: Strictly ascending ladder of spacing values; any Margin/Padding component off this ladder is DG0002.

fontSizes.description: Named font-size tokens. A 'Body' entry is required and must be >= 16 (legibility floor).

hitTargetFloor.description: Touch hit-target floor. Values below 44 are a configuration error.

uniformSpacingKeys.description: Glob key families treated as uniform spacing tokens (DG0004 judgement data).

lineHeights.description: Font-size key to line-height mapping; data source of the DG0007 fix.

clickableTypes.description: Clickable control type list (DG0008/0009/0017 judgement data).

inlineInputTypes.description: Inline input element types (DG0004/0016 judgement data).

styleLibrary.description: Style library definition file glob (DG0017 coverage gate).

hardZero.description: File glob -> rule IDs. Hits inside a domain are always red regardless of the baseline; baseline --update never relaxes them, and exemptions pointing into a domain are a configuration error.

file.description: Path relative to scope.root; directory-level exemptions are forbidden.

count.description: Registered occurrence count; a mismatch with actual hits is a stale exemption (red).

type.description: Optional type-scoped exemption for coverage gates (DG0017).

date.description: ISO date the baseline was last (re)written.

counts.description: Global per-rule ratchet counters; absent rules are 0 (any hit is red).

files.description: Per-file snapshots (written by init). Data source of the cold-start downgrade: hits within the snapshot compile as warnings, others as errors.
